title: Page not found
summary: Docs empty state with one strong line, one muted line, return and search actions.
compare: The empty state uses a stationary star in a subtle icon tile.
It names the missing page and offers Back to the docs and search.
No sidebar or active door is implied.

designReview.reviewer: pkey-ux-reviewer (rendered consumer, developer and brand lenses)
designReview.verdict: Brand and consumer review passed: the empty state stays neutral, names the missing page and offers only return and search paths.
